answer: Filling 58 aliases hence means producing 58 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. Because the atlas count is verified against the mesa text itself, the vertex audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 5 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. That is 25 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
